text: Dr Marc is brilliant. This was a completely different experience to the acupuncture I am used to but was very effective. I had gone in with a sore shoulder and neck and in a few appointments he really helped the pain. Unfortunately I had to leave Phuket otherwise I would’ve continued going. Thank you so much 🙏🏼 …

I unexpectedly had an intestinal ulcer flare while on vacation causing a rash on my hands along the large intestine meridian - something I've experienced before and that my acupuncturist at home works on with amazing results. I was greatful to find him and that he was available to see me the same day I called. He works out of his home which may be different than what Westeners are accustomed to but was spot on with treatment. The rash subsided considerably by the next morning and was healed within 2 days following. My husband also received his very first accupuncture treatment with him, helped considerably with his neck/shoulder pain and he slept better than he had our entire trip that night. I highly recommend his services - thank you sir!

An acupuncturist with truly miraculous hands. In just one treatment, he resolved years of recurring urinary tract inflammation that I had struggled with. I have the deepest respect for this incredible person, his profound knowledge, and his holistic approach to healing. Thanks to him, I now have yet another  reason to return to beautiful Phuket to mantain good health.

Marc did a great job – very professional, kind and caring. I feel balanced again and my Qi is flowing in the right direction. Thank you!
Highly recommended

I’ve been seeing Marc for a few years now. He is a very experienced acupuncturist. Extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and inviting. I highly recommend Marc to all! I travel around the world quite a bit, and I’ve not been able to find another acupuncturist who delivers the same result.

Having suffered from migraines for months, finding relief seemed like an endless struggle. With no appointment and desperation for relief, I turned to Marc for help. He gave me a spontaneous appointment which the relief was immediate. Within just three days, the intensity of my migraines decreased significantly. Highly recommend. Five stars without hesitation!
Amazing treatment had problems with my lower back and feet and in only one session he fixed it completely, very friendly swiss guy I definitely recommended marc if you have any type of illness

Had my first accupure with Marc,
Without any expectations, I got surprised by a multitude of reactions and improvements.. Looking forward for my next session!
Really good! It helped me a lot
My first ever acupuncture. He knew immediately what is my issue even without telling him a word. Both physical and mental. I feel 10x better right after that.

A childhood classmate from the Collège de la Pontaise in Lausanne. Thanks to Facebook, I was able to find and reconnect with this friend, 55 years after losing touch. This year, more precisely in September 2025, I traveled to the Phuket region. There, I reconnected with Marc, who lives 7 kilometers from my hotel near Chalong!

We met up again 55 years later as if we had never lost touch! Thank you, life, for this wonderful gift!

We shared many stories about our life journeys and especially about music, particularly about a Swiss band, Yello! Only those who were there at the time will understand…
Furthermore, Marc gave me an acupuncture treatment, as he is a recognized practitioner! A thousand thanks, Marc, for taking the time to share your passion by playing your drum with your friends and their various drum and bass instruments on your beach at Nai Harn Beach, near Rawai—a symbol of freedom, emotion, and love…
See you very soon, my friend, and above all, take good care of yourself and your family!

With love, Pierre
